The largest ocean on Earth is the **Pacific Ocean**. It covers about 63 million square miles (165 million square kilometers), which is roughly one-third of the Earth's surface and more than the total land area of all continents combined.

Some key facts about the Pacific Ocean:
- It stretches from the Arctic Ocean in the north to the Southern (Antarctic) Ocean in the south
- Its deepest point is the **Mariana Trench**, specifically the Challenger Deep, which reaches about 36,000 feet (nearly 11,000 meters) below sea level — deeper than Mount Everest is tall
